review_evidence: README describes a Lean API for MySQL with database creation, queries and a SQL syntax DSL.
Complete scan of eight Lean files finds a single theorem, DataFrame.consistentConcatOfConsistentRow, used internally to construct a well-typed DataFrame after appending a row.

All remaining primary content is SQL syntax/elaboration, database FFI/API, dataframe implementation and Lake/native build support; there is no independently proved SQL/database semantics or query-correctness development.

source_action.content_invariant: Across all eight Lean files, the only proposition declaration is the local DataFrame row-consistency helper used by addRow; the rest is SQL syntax/elaboration, MySQL IO/FFI and data/API implementation. Retirement therefore hides no independent mathematical or formal-semantics corpus.
evidence: README identifies the project as an API for the MySQL database.
Complete proposition scan found exactly one theorem in lib/DataFrame.lean and no other theorem/lemma/axiom/example declarations.
Inspection of that theorem shows it only preserves the DataFrame rowsOfTypes invariant when concatenating a row; no SQL/database semantics or correctness theory is developed.
source_action.rationale: LeanMySQL is a general-purpose database client/DSL implementation; its sole theorem is an internal DataFrame construction invariant, not an independent formal specification or theorem development.

summary: Reviewed LeanMySQL and retire it as database/API implementation rather than an independent formalization source.
